exposure: long-term exposure to high levels of testosterone
cohort: Transgender men (mean age: 27.6 ± 1.7 years; range 20-34 years, n = 8) taking pre-operative testosterone therapy and age-matched healthy women (mean age: 31.8±1.5 years; range= 25-35 years, n=8) obtained at caesarean section
finding: High circulating concentrations of testosterone are associated with reduced follicle growth activation, poor follicle health and increased DNA damage in ovarian follicles.
mod_finding: The study used ovarian tissue from healthy women obtained during cesarean sections as a control group to investigate the effect of testosterone on ovarian follicles.
